action.command:
for p in \
  "/examples/Basic/../mastercode/3_27_1/js/masterportal.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/masterportal.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/css/masterportal.css" \
  "/examples/Basic/config.js" \
  "/examples/Basic/config.json" \
  "/examples/Basic/resources/services.json" \
  "/examples/Basic/resources/rest-services.json" \
  "/examples/Basic/resources/style_v3.json" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/locales/en/common.json" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/img/Logo_Masterportal.svg" ; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost$p"); echo "$code  $p";
done; echo; echo "=== masterportal.js size check ==="; curl -s http://localhost/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/masterportal.js | wc -c; stat -c '%s bytes on disk' /var/www/html/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/masterportal.js
